title: 第3章 烂地好起家第4章 黑街的王
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 原先掌控黑滩镇的小贵族濒临破产。
对方当时欠了伯爵不少钱。
只能拿那块领地来抵账。
这件事在程序上经过国王批准，属于合法的领地交易。
而在接手黑滩镇之前，伯爵就明白那是个坑货。
伯爵主要是基于“不要就什么都没有”的考量才选择接受。
所以他也不愿在那儿耗费太多精力。
大多时候都放手让代理人管理。
毕竟在黑水海盗攫取贡金后，黑滩镇的财税几乎年年都在亏损
那里的人口也在逐年流失，状况不是很乐观。
想去黑滩镇，走陆路最少得月余。
期间还得穿过另外几个贵族的领地。
若是顺着月河入海，再从家族另外两座港口乘船北上。
在顺风的条件下，全程大约也要5~7日。
足可见那块地盘是多么偏远
但罗德明白，只有这样才能促使伯爵答应他的请求。
而且还不会遭受路易斯方面的阻挠。
随着长子的年岁渐长，拜伦伯爵也比较注重对方的看法了。
于是，父子二人达成了共识。
对于拜伦伯爵而言，他其实也愿意给罗德一个机会。
只是希望罗德未来不会出现在蛮族用以勒索赎金的囚车中。
敲定了一些细则后。
伯爵为罗德签署了次级采邑的契约。
今后他将作为家族分封的勋爵入主黑滩镇。
该领地在罗德死后将会被收回，无法被他的子女继承。
不过罗德若是能得到国王的封爵，就能自立家门选择一个新姓氏。
如果跟主家关系密切，新的姓氏往往会跟主家近似。
比如史塔克和卡史塔克，一眼就知道是主脉和支脉的关系。
封主封臣制就是这样，国王才是名义上最大的地主。
许多遵循法理的扩张都绕不开国王的点头。
但“我附庸的附庸不是我的附庸”。
所以封主想要收回土地时结果往往是不尽如人愿的。
而在几百年前，王族威势衰落的时期。
王国内的各个贵族还时常互相攻伐，甚至侵占彼此的领地。
具体情况完全取决于王族和贵族利益集团的潜在博弈。
顺利拿到了盖有家主印章的契约。
罗德对此感到满意。

The small nobles who originally controlled Black Beach Town were on the verge of bankruptcy.
The other party owed the earl a lot of money at the time.
We can only use that territory to offset the debt.
This matter was procedurally approved by the king and was a legal territorial transaction.
Before taking over Black Beach Town, the Earl knew that it was a scam.
The Earl chose to accept it mainly based on the consideration of "if you don't want it, you will have nothing".
So he didn't want to spend too much energy there.
Most of the time, let the agent manage it.
After all, after the Blackwater Pirates seized tribute, Black Beach Town's finances and taxes have been losing money almost every year.
The population there is also losing year by year, and the situation is not very optimistic.
If you want to go to Heitan Town, you have to travel by land for at least more than a month.
During this period, he had to pass through the territories of several other nobles.
If you follow the Moon River into the sea, then take a boat from the other two ports of the family to go north.
Under favorable wind conditions, the whole journey will take about 5 to 7 days.
This shows how remote that land is.
But Rhodes understood that only in this way could the earl agree to his request.
And there will be no obstruction from Lewis.
As his eldest son grew older, Earl Byron paid more attention to his opinions.
As a result, the father and son reached a consensus.
As for Earl Byron, he was actually willing to give Rhodes a chance.
I just hope that Rhodes will not appear in the prison car used by the barbarians to extort ransom in the future.
After finalizing some details.
The earl signed a deed for the secondary fief for Rhodes.
From now on, he will take over Black Beach Town as a feudal lord of his family.
The territory will be recovered after Rhodes's death and cannot be inherited by his children.
However, if Rhodes can be knighted by the king, he can start his own family and choose a new surname.
If there is a close relationship with the main family, the new surname will often be similar to the main family.
For example, Stark and Karstark can tell at a glance the relationship between the main vein and the branch vein.
This is the system of feudal vassalage. The king is the largest landowner in name.
Many expansions that follow legal principles cannot avoid the king's nod.
But "the vassals I vassal are not my vassals."
Therefore, when the feudal lord wanted to take back the land, the result was often unsatisfactory.
But hundreds of years ago, the power of the royal family declined.
Various nobles in the kingdom often attack each other and even occupy each other's territory.
The specific situation depends entirely on the potential game between the royal family and aristocratic interest groups.
I successfully obtained the contract with the seal of the family owner.
Rod was satisfied with this.
